assumptions: 1.5 seconds interpreted as 1500 ms for DWELL min_ms.
'crosses into packing' interpreted as CROSSES packing_entry in direction to_left, since rightwards (+x) travel is labeled to_left and boxes travel left to right.
'stay' interpreted as continuous presence regardless of motion, so DWELL with max_speed null rather than stopped.
No maximum gap required between dwell and crossing, so within_ms is null.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously via IMPLIES(OCCURS(B), BEFORE(A,B)) idiom.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every blue box that crosses packing_entry to_left must have dwelled at least 1500 ms continuously in inspection before that crossing.

text: Every blue box must stay at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone before it crosses into packing.
